Iron:
Zinc:
Vit D:
Vit B12:
Vit C:
Vit E:
Calcium:
Iodine:
Selenium:

Answer (Back):

Iron: Anovulation (lack of ovulation), fatigue, poor embryo implantation
Zinc: Irregular menstrual cycles, reduced egg maturation, poor sperm quality
Vit D:  Irregular cycle, poor overian reserve, increased risk of infertility
Vit B12: Impaired egg maturation, increased risk of miscarriage
Vit C: Oxidative damage to reproductive cells, lower fertility rates
Vit E: Poor egg quality, reduced implantation success
Calcium: Hormonal imbalances potential impacts on early fetal development
Iodine: Subfertility, increased risk of miscarriage, impaired fetal neurodevelopment
Selenium: Increased oxidative stress, reduced fertility in both sexes
Omega-3 FA: Hormonal imbalances, reduced embryo implantation success
